title: The RF-185 Live timing test passes under machine load
acceptance: The 200 ms wall-clock assertion in LiveMode.test.tsx (RF-185) uses a fake clock or a bound that holds under load, and still fails if the double start it guards returns.
nextAction: Seen on 2026-11-13: the test failed once in a local pnpm test run while three agents ran gates on one machine, and passed on rerun; CI was green. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Reported by the RF-136 agent during its local gate for #768: one failure under heavy load, pass on a full rerun. Other suites also needed reruns under the same load (web UI 5 s timeouts, an integration worker RPC timeout) during #767's gate.
